ratios.quote: Maximum permitted leverage ratio (1) 4.50 times 1.92 times

parsed.notes: Ratio is total debt to deemed consolidated EBITDA as defined by the credit agreement. The 4.50x limit is a temporary step-up following the Axonics Qualified Acquisition (closed Nov 2024; 4.75x initially). It steps down to 4.25x and then 4.00x before returning to the base of 3.75x. Consolidated EBITDA excludes certain restructuring charges (up to $500M, now fully used) and net cash litigation payments. The same table appears in both the MD&A and the notes; it is reported once here.
